YT Premium Vibe for Chrome — Setup Guide
========================================

Makes YouTube feel premium in Chrome: ad blocking, sponsor skip, no Shorts,
AI summaries (English/Bangla), volume boost, Picture-in-Picture, cinema mode and more.

Works on Windows, Mac and Linux in Google Chrome (also Edge and Brave).


STEP 1 — Unzip
--------------
Unzip the file (Windows: right-click → Extract All). You get a folder called
"YT-Premium-Vibe-for-Chrome" with manifest.json directly inside it.
Move that folder somewhere you'll keep it (for example Documents).
Don't delete it later: Chrome loads the extension from this folder.


STEP 2 — Add it to Chrome
-------------------------
  1. Open Chrome and go to:  chrome://extensions
  2. Turn on "Developer mode" (top right).
  3. Click "Load unpacked" and choose the "YT-Premium-Vibe-for-Chrome" folder.
     Open it first if you're unsure: you should see manifest.json inside.
     ("Manifest file is missing" means you picked a folder one level too high or too low.)
  4. Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar and pin "YT Premium Vibe".
  5. Open youtube.com (reload it if it was already open).


STEP 3 — AI Summary (free)
--------------------------
  1. Go to https://aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with your Google account.
  2. Click "Create API key" and copy it.
  3. On any YouTube video, click "AI Summary", paste the key, and click "Save & summarize".
  Click "বাংলা" at the top of the panel for summaries in Bangla.


Download button (Windows, one-time setup)
-----------------------------------------
  1. In the "YT-Premium-Vibe-for-Chrome" folder, double-click INSTALL-DOWNLOAD-HELPER.bat.
     If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click "More info" -> "Run anyway".
  2. Wait until it says "Done!" (it downloads yt-dlp and ffmpeg, a few minutes), then press a key.
  3. Close every Chrome window and open Chrome again.
  4. Click "Download" under any YouTube video. Files go to your Downloads folder,
     and "Show in folder" opens it when done.
  No admin rights needed. It works in Chrome, Edge and Brave.
  Mac or Linux with Chrome: one-click download isn't available; the button offers
  "Copy yt-dlp command" instead (or use the Safari version on Mac).


Updating
--------
Download the new zip, replace the old folder's contents with the new ones,
then click the ↻ reload icon on YT Premium Vibe in chrome://extensions.
